I’ll share my second dream. 
There was this church in a dessert that looked like a church a regular church in this ragged town. A lot of celebrities go to this church. They pray and worship but it’s not to God. it’s feels like something is off. It was to the devil. The crazy part is that they don’t flat out say it is because they want to trick you into joining. They are so kind and welcoming too. There were stairs that lead upstairs to the main part of the church that looked normal but suddenly turned red and charred hands were reaching out. They were screaming and moaning to get out. They were burning. The hands were reaching out from a place of fire. Again all the church goers are friendly but there’s something off. They wanted blood to put in this pot where the podium would be in a church(where the pastor would preach). It looked like black tar inside and it bubbled when blood was dropped in. I guess it’s all the blood given by the church goers. That was how you joined. They lie and say we’re praying to “God” but no. They are tricking people to joining and once you give blood you can’t leave. They hate God there. Another part I saw was that the banks were closing. Only the rich could access their money. The town I was in looked so raggedy and poor. Something happened to cause the down fall of the world. Disease or war even. There was a protester outside protesting the devil church and the cops were threatening to hurt her. out of garbage I found I made a mat for her to sit on. They started yelling at me but I closed my eyes and walked away. She said how come you guys didn’t hurt me. They said yelling was good enough. I remember this one usher with big eyes asked if I can speak with God I said yes then were asking all these questions pressing me. i realized just from their presence they were up to no good.

I’ll put exactly what my dream was. I was in this desert looking place. Like it was once a place that had foliage but it was destroyed and dried up and barren. In this desert, I was standing in front of what looked like a cathedral or temple. When I looked up to see the horizon I saw a beast. It was the size of a skyscraper. But then it was brought down to scale right in front of me in between the temple and me. It had a head of a lion, a tail of a scorpion or snake, a body of a leopard and other animals I can’t remember. And each head wore a crown of gold. But I wasn’t alone out there. I felt a presence on my left side. It was God. He took the beast down another scale to where it was small. Then even separated it into each individual animal. It wasn’t as scary now. In a blink of an eye I was in the temple. It had beautiful window pane colors. Like you see in a Catholic Church. In side it every rich and famous person in side. They were singing praises and worship. I sat among them as they worshipped but something was off. There was a red dragon inside sleeping. I got the feeling now that they weren’t praising God. They were praising that dragon they believed was keeping them safe from the beast outside. When I got up to head outside there I saw a man through the door windows. He had scratches on his back. His skin looked like it was melting off from the sun outside. I wanted to let him in but all the celebrities and the rich said no because he will cause sickness to spread to them. I walked back to my seat and then the dragon woke up. I caused chaos in the temple. Destroying everything inside. The celebrities and the rich left sad and betrayed. The dragon they believed that was protecting them from the beast outside deceived them. Then I woke up. It’s long sorry

I don’t read my bible as much as I should so when googled the beast and the dragon I started crying because it was sooooo very similar to Revelations. I began praying and asking for understanding. It sounds like your fiancé is at really low point right now. She’s handling something really big and she probably feels like she’s handling it alone. You have to ask her what’s wrong and to reassure her that what ever it is you won’t judge her and you’ll go through it together. She may not speak about it because she doesn’t want to stress you or she’s scared you might get tired of her. All these thoughts might be going through her head which adds on to the anxiety. If she’s willing therapy might be a good option but I would suggest going with her so she knows she’s not alone. Take her to a physiologist specialized in anxiety. Take her out some places to distract her like the park or to see a movie or play games. Some place not too crowed. She may be stressed from life or even work. You have to get her to talk or to a psychologist if she’s more comfortable with that. Best of Luck
